test: Q4 v2: Vocabulary adds essentiality signal beyond sequence similarity

test_A_residual.interpretation: BLAST-proxy departments explain 1.8% of essentiality variance. After removing this signal, vocabulary departments explain an additional 2.3% of the remaining variance (residual eta2 = 0.0236, p_perm = 0.0000). This demonstrates that the vocabulary captures functional information about gene essentiality that sequence similarity alone does not.

conclusion: The vocabulary's functional signal is significantly independent of sequence similarity. After BLAST-proxy departments explain 1.8% of essentiality variance, vocabulary departments explain an additional 2.3% of residual variance (p_perm = 0.0000, 2000 permutations).
